description: This file contains classes and functions for converting data between local Python data structures and Apache Arrow tables, specifically for PySpark SQL integration. It includes methods for creating converters based on data types, converting data sequences to Arrow tables, and converting Arrow tables back to rows.

classes.name: LocalDataToArrowConversion
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting local Python data structures to Apache Arrow format, including logic for handling various Spark data types.

classes.name: ArrowTableToRowsConversion
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting Apache Arrow tables to Python row structures, including handling of various Spark data types.

methods.name: _need_converter
methods.description: Determines if a given data type requires conversion to Arrow format.

methods.name: _create_converter
methods.description: Creates a conversion function for a specific data type, considering nullability and other options.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a sequence of data into a pyarrow Table based on a provided schema.
